channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Endereço atribuído a Flávio Bolsonaro na filiação ao Missão foi 'Rua dos Bandidos' e 'Bairro dos Milicianos'
item.description: A document from the Missão party shows that Flávio Bolsonaro was fraudulently affiliated with the party using a fictitious address ('Rua Dos Bandidos, n° 666, Bairro Miliciano') by an unidentified third party who misused the party’s own credentials. Flávio’s campaign claims this blocks his PL presidential candidacy registration, while Missão alleges to have proof someone accessed his email and confirmed the affiliation. The TSE ruled out a hacker attack, stating the affiliation resulted from improper use of the party’s tools by someone with legitimate access to its credentials.

item.title: Nunes Marques restabelece filiação de Flávio ao PL e determina exclusão do vínculo com o Missão
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques restored Flávio Bolsonaro's affiliation with the PL and ordered the removal of the fraudulent link to the Missão Party, enabling immediate registration of his presidential candidacy. The TSE concluded the Missão affiliation stemmed from improper use of credentials, not hacking, and requested a PF investigation.

item.title: Lula grava programa eleitoral com João Campos para Pernambuco
item.description: President Lula recorded the electoral program for João Campos, the PSB candidate for Governor of Pernambuco, ending controversy over the use of two political slates in the state. The recording reinforces Lula's support for Campos, who is running against Governor Raquel Lyra of the PSD. The event took place this Friday (14).

item.title: Campanha de Flávio rebate nota do Missão sobre filiação: 'Molecagem'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) presidential campaign criticized the Missão party's note regarding his alleged fraudulent affiliation, calling it 'nonsense' and stating it fails to clarify what occurred. The campaign attempted to register his candidacy with the TSE this morning but was blocked because he was affiliated with Missão yesterday, creating a legal impediment.

item.title: Haddad cobra segurança e critica gestão Tarcísio após ação da PM
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT), candidate for governor of São Paulo, said he needs to feel safe during the electoral process after reporting a suspicious police approach near his home. He also criticized the security management of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans), linking the incident to the state's current public safety policies.

item.title: TSE: Kássio enviou representação ao MP para providências sobre filiação de Flávio ao Missão
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kássio Nunes Marques, submitted a representation to the Electoral General Prosecutor's Office (PGE) requesting action regarding the affiliation of pre-candidate Flávio Dino to the Mission party. The move aims to clarify whether there are any irregularities in the politician's party membership, in accordance with electoral law.

item.title: “A chance de ser uma malandragem é enorme”, diz Renan sobre filiação de Flávio
item.description: Renan Santos, a candidate from the Missão party, stated that the party can prove someone accessed Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's official email and confirmed his affiliation with the party, along with access to the militia app. He suggested the situation amounts to 'skullduggery' due to the high likelihood of irregularity.

item.title: Prazo para mudar de partido acabou em abril; entenda condições de elegibilidade
item.description: The deadline to change parties for the 2026 general elections ended on April 4, a requirement for eligibility for all offices. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) had his presidential candidacy blocked due to appearing affiliated with the Missão party in Electoral Justice records, despite being the PL's nominee. The TSE denied it was a hacker attack, stating the registration resulted from improper use of credentials by someone affiliated with the Missão party.

item.title: Defesa de Flávio pede que PF investigue fraude em sistema do TSE
item.description: The defense of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) filed an urgent request with the TSE for the Federal Police to investigate an alleged fraud in the party affiliation system, claiming he was wrongfully linked to the Mission Party without his consent days before the presidential candidacy registration deadline. The change occurred between August 12 and 13, when the FILIA system showed his disaffiliation from the PL due to a 'more recent affiliation' with the Mission Party, which the defense claims was intended to block his candidacy registration. The defense seeks immediate restoration of his PL affiliation, removal of the invalid Mission Party affiliation, access to the Candex system for candidacy registration, and preservation of digital evidence.

item.title: Renan diz que quem filiou Flávio Bolsonaro acessou conta de e-mail do senador para confirmação; cadastro informa 'Rua dos Bandidos' como endereço do candidato do PL
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, claimed that an unauthorized access to Flávio Bolsonaro's email was used to fraudulently enroll the senator in the party, citing internal documents showing a fictitious address ('Rua dos Bandidos'). Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign denies the enrollment and states that the TSE cannot register his candidacy due to this inconsistency, while the Missão party asserts that Bolsonaro's office was aware of the incident and failed to act to correct it.

item.title: TRE manda Facebook retirar do ar posts impulsionados contra Haddad
item.description: The TRE-SP ordered Facebook to take down three boosted posts from a fake profile that falsely claimed Fernando Haddad (PT) would increase taxes. The posts, labeled as 'dark posts', were suspended and the profile 'Plantão Brasil 24h' was removed. The ruling aims to ensure transparency and electoral oversight in São Paulo.

item.title: Plano de Flávio vai propor programa de pontuação para empreendedoras
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s government plan proposes the 'Ganha, Ganha' program, a points-based system for women entrepreneurs, where completing training courses, working regularly, saving, and paying bills on time earn points redeemable for financial benefits such as lower interest rates, cashback, and easier credit access. The initiative aims to recognize the often-overlooked efforts of women excluded from formal finance and promote economic independence, with voluntary participation and backing from public banks including Caixa, Banco da Amazônia, and Banco do Nordeste.

item.title: Filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão: veja o que já se sabe
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) was unable to register his presidential candidacy after appearing improperly affiliated with the Mission Party in Electoral Justice systems. The TSE ruled out hacking, citing misuse of credentials by someone affiliated with the Mission Party, while the PL filed a disaffiliation request currently under review. The final deadline for candidate registration is Saturday, March 15, at 7 p.m.

item.title: Fila, maquiagem e vídeos curtos: os bastidores das gravações com Lula
item.description: President Lula recorded short videos with over 30 allied candidates at his campaign headquarters in Brasília, with makeup support and quick productions for TV, radio and social media. Behind-the-scenes details included queues, makeup touch-ups and Lula’s upbeat demeanor, helping shy candidates feel comfortable. Some, like Patrus Ananias (MG), had longer sessions and praised the president’s leniency.

item.title: Crusoé: Flávio aparece no Missão como morador da “Rua dos Bandidos”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's registration with the Missão party featured an unusual address: "Rua dos Bandidos" in the "Bairro Miliciano", with number 666 and a non-existent ZIP code. While his party affiliation was already seen as unconventional, the address detail sparked controversy and mockery on social media. The story was reported by Crusoé and picked up by O Antagonista.

item.title: Em tom de chacota, cadastro falso diz que Flávio Bolsonaro mora na "Rua dos Bandidos"
item.description: A false registration made in the name of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) used mocking data, assigning him the address 'Rua dos Bandidos', number 666, in the 'Miliciano Neighborhood', Rio de Janeiro, and affiliating him with the Mission Party. The article, exclusive to subscribers, emphasizes the humorous and provocative nature of the fake registration, with no confirmation of authenticity or involvement by the senator.

item.title: Kassab sobre Flávio Bolsonaro: ‘Por que não defendeu as vacinas na pandemia?’
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD and vice-presidential candidate, criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for not defending vaccines during the pandemic, despite having influence as the son of former President Jair Bolsonaro. Kassab said the Bolsonaro family, while in power, hindered vaccination efforts and that public officials must act when they hold authority. He emphasized that the PSD supports science and vaccines, in contrast to recent Bolsonarist denialism.

item.title: A fortuna declarada por Eduardo Cunha em seu retorno às urnas
item.description: Eduardo Cunha, former Chamber president removed from office during Operation Car Wash, is running again in the 2026 elections as a federal deputy candidate for Minas Gerais, declaring R$ 14.1 million in assets — nearly identical to his 2022 declaration. His wealth is largely tied to a R$ 12.5 million judicial deposit at Caixa Economica, plus real estate, business stakes, and a car. His candidacy is being challenged in electoral court over alleged ineligibility due to an administrative misconduct conviction, while he is also under STF investigation for allegedly influencing parliamentary amendments despite holding no mandate.

item.title: PL não consegue registrar Flávio como candidato após fraude alterar filiação do senador para partido Missão, afirma campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign claims it was unable to register his presidential candidacy due to a fraud that altered his party affiliation in the Electoral Justice system to the Mission party, created last year. Campaign lawyer Maria Claudia Bucchianeri suspects improper password use or malicious action, stating the senator lacks regular affiliation, blocking registration before the Saturday 7 p.m. deadline. The PL has appealed to the TSE to correct the affiliation and investigate, while the court said the investigation is underway and ruled out system hacking.

item.title: Pedido de vista interrompe julgamento do TSE sobre cálculo do Fundo Eleitoral para o PT
item.description: Minister Estela Aranha requested a pause (vista), halting the TSE's judgment on the PT's petition to recalculate the Electoral Fund distribution for the 2026 elections. The PT claims an error in counting its congressional caucus — 68 instead of the 69 elected in 2022 — which would affect its share of campaign funds. Relator Kassio Nunes Marques voted against the petition, warning that the decision could impact all parties and that no funds will be distributed until the ruling is finalized.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aciona TSE e pede medida de urgência para voltar ao PL
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed an urgent request with the TSE to reverse his affiliation with the Missão party and return to the PL, claiming the change was made improperly by a third party using the party's credentials. The petition was filed two days before the candidacy registration deadline and also requests a PF investigation into alleged fraud. The TSE denies hacking, stating the change resulted from unauthorized use of the party's login credentials.

item.title: 'Só sabem jogar sujo', diz Flávio Bolsonaro após ser filiado ao Missão; PL aponta fraude, e TSE manda investigar
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro was improperly affiliated with the Missão party, blocking his presidential candidacy registration under the PL coalition. The TSE ruled out hacking, citing misuse of Missão’s credentials, and ordered a judicial investigation and referral to the PGE. Bolsonaro accused opponents of fraud, declaring he will not back down.

item.title: TSE diz que troca de filiação de Flávio foi feita por pessoa com uso de credenciais do Missão; Nunes Marques manda investigar caso
item.description: The TSE confirmed that Flávio Bolsonaro's party affiliation change to Missão was made by an authorized person using the party's credentials, not through hacking, and ordered an investigation by the PGE and Judicial Police. The incident temporarily blocked his PL presidential candidacy due to dual affiliation rules. The PL has requested the affiliation be annulled, and the request is under review by the Electoral Justice.

item.title: TSE nega ataque hacker na filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão e abre inquérito para investigar
item.description: The TSE denied that the fraudulent affiliation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro with the Mission party resulted from a hacker attack, stating it was carried out by someone with the party’s credentials. The TSE president ordered a judicial police investigation and forwarded a representation to the PGE to address the improper use of the affiliation system. The PL has already filed a request to disaffiliate Bolsonaro from the party.

item.title: TSE pede à PF investigação sobre filiação de Flávio à Missão
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has requested the Federal Police to investigate the alleged irregular affiliation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) with the Missão party, ruling out a hacker attack on the party affiliation system. According to the Court, the incident resulted from the improper use of the tool by someone who possessed the necessary credentials, suggesting possible internal fraud or abuse. The TSE has asked for an inquiry to clarify responsibilities and ensure the integrity of the electoral process.

item.title: Tribunal mantém multa a instituto por irregularidade em pesquisa eleitoral de 2024
item.description: The TSE upheld a fine of R$ 53,205 imposed on the Quaest research institute for disseminating an irregular electoral poll in the 2024 Municipal Elections in Teresina (PI), due to the lack of clear geographical delimitation of the surveyed neighborhoods. The decision was made by a majority, following the rapporteur’s vote, Minister Antonio Carlos Ferreira, who emphasized that while pollsters have methodological autonomy, they must still comply with legal requirements and TSE Resolution No. 23.600/2019.

item.title: TSE cassa vereador que praticou violência política contra colega mulher em Nova Friburgo (RJ)
item.description: The TSE unanimously removed councilman José Sebastião Rabello (Solidariedade) from Nova Friburgo (RJ) for gender-based political violence against councilwoman Priscila Teixeira Pitta Muniz (PT). He was sentenced to one year in prison, replaced by community service, had his political rights suspended, and was declared ineligible. Minister Dias Toffoli emphasized the seriousness of the acts, stating Rabello subjected his colleague to humiliations, threats, and discrimination inside the City Council to obstruct her mandate due to her gender.

item.title: Renan Santos critica Flávio: 'Brasil se ilude com farsa bolsonarista'
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from the Missão party, criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), calling Brazil's belief in the Bolsonarist narrative a 'farce'. He also criticized the federal government during an event in São Paulo's southern zone.

item.title: A explicação do TSE para a filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's affiliation with the Mission party was not due to a hack, but to the improper use of the party's credentials by someone with authorized access. President Nunes Marques ordered a police investigation and referred the matter to the Electoral General Prosecutor's Office. The PL has requested Flávio's disaffiliation, and the request is under review.

item.title: "Só sabem jogar sujo", diz Flávio Bolsonaro após filiação no Missão
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and presidential candidate, denounced alleged fraud in his affiliation with the Missão party, claiming the system is trying to block his candidacy. In a social media post, he stated that those who 'only know how to play dirty' will fail to stop him, as God is on his side and Brazil will prevail. The accompanying video reinforces his narrative of institutional persecution and divine confidence.

item.title: TSE diz que credenciado do Missão filiou Flávio Bolsonaro ao partido e nega ataque hacker
item.description: The TSE denied that Flávio Bolsonaro's affiliation with the Missão party resulted from a hacker attack, stating it occurred due to improper use of the party's own credentials. The TSE president referred the matter to the PGE and ordered a police investigation. The Liberal Party has requested his disaffiliation, which is under review by the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Nunes Marques é convencido a barrar IA com Bolsonaro, mas desperta dúvida sobre punir Flávio
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques was persuaded to ban the use of avatars in the 2026 presidential campaigns, labeling the technology as 'deepfake'. The decision followed the use of the technique by Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign, which displayed jailed former president Jair Bolsonaro at a party convention via AI-generated avatar. The move raises uncertainty over whether Flávio Bolsonaro will face sanctions for the misuse of AI.

item.title: Missão fala em filiação "fraudulenta" de Flávio Bolsonaro ao partido
item.description: The Missão party denounced that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) affiliation with the party was fraudulent, stating the senator’s office was informed of the attempt since August 2 without responding. The TSE ruled out a hacker attack and confirmed the registration was made by a party representative, which is now seeking to reverse the filing and has contacted the PF and Electoral Justice to identify those responsible.

item.title: Lula terá nova reunião com Alcolumbre nesta quinta (13/8)
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) will meet again with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) on Thursday, August 13, following a meeting the previous day at the Alvorada Palace. The restricted meeting aims to rebuild relations and advance three key government priorities: the PEC to end the 6×1 work scale, the Public Security PEC, and the Rare Lands Bill. Government leaders Camilo Santana and Randolfe Rodrigues emphasized the goal is to accelerate votes before the 2026 municipal elections.

item.title: A resposta do Missão sobre a filiação fraudulenta envolvendo Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Missão Party denounced a fraudulent affiliation involving Flávio Bolsonaro, stating its system detected the attempt and tried to cancel it, but the TSE rejected the request. The party said Flávio’s office was notified since May 2 but did not respond to emails. Bolsonaro could not register his candidacy due to appearing affiliated with Missão, and both parties requested a PF investigation.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aparece filiado ao partido Missão
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, was erroneously linked to the Mission party in TSE systems despite being affiliated with the Liberal Party. The Mission party stated on Thursday that it was a case of fraud and said it is taking all appropriate actions with the Federal Police and the Electoral Court. The incident raises suspicions of electoral data manipulation in an election year.

item.title: Missão diz ter sido alvo de fraude em filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro e que avisou gabinete de senador, mas não teve resposta
item.description: The Mission party claims it was the target of a fraudulent registration of Flávio Bolsonaro, who was enrolled in its rolls without consent through the TSE system, blocking his presidential candidacy registration by the PL. The party says it attempted to cancel the enrollment the same day, but the TSE rejected the request, and that it notified the senator’s office on April 2, with emails opened but unanswered. Mission will file a complaint with the PF and TSE to identify those responsible, citing ideological misalignment and corruption suspicions.

item.title: Renan Santos e Kim brincam com Flávio no Missão: "Não façam isso"
item.description: Renan Santos and Kim Kataguiri joked about the unauthorized registration of Flávio Bolsonaro into the Missão party, which blocked his presidential candidacy in the TSE system. They stated the filings were made by a party representative, not due to a hacker attack, and Flávio plans to correct the record, possibly involving the Federal Police.

item.title: Fraude barra registro de candidatura de Flávio, que consta como filiado ao Missão no TSE
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential candidacy registration was delayed due to a fraud in his electoral registration, which incorrectly shows him as affiliated with the Missão party instead of the PL. His campaign claims it was a prank and says the issue will be resolved by the end of the day. Missão party states it was the victim of a fraudulent affiliation attempt and says it notified Bolsonaro's team as early as the 2nd of the month.

item.title: TSE adia reunião para discutir IA nas campanhas
item.description: The TSE postponed Thursday's meeting to discuss the limits of AI use in electoral campaigns after the morning plenary session ran longer than expected. A key issue under debate is whether deepfakes should be banned in all cases or only when they risk misleading voters. The decision will influence the evaluation of an AI-generated video of former President Jair Bolsonaro, shared during the convention that confirmed his son Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy.

item.title: O patrimônio de Fernando Haddad declarado à Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) declared a total wealth of R$ 861,217.25 in the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial election, with his largest asset being a financial investment of R$ 359,328.43. His patrimony increased by 44% compared to 2022, when he declared R$ 595,059.29. His main opponent, Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans), declared nearly R$ 2.7 million in assets, representing a growth of approximately R$ 400,000 since 2022.

item.title: Missão diz ser 'vítima' e que alertou gabinete de Flávio Bolsonaro 10 dias antes sobre tentativa de fraude
item.description: The Mission Party claims it was the victim of a fraudulent affiliation attempt involving Flávio Bolsonaro and tried to cancel the affiliation the same day, but the TSE rejected the action. The party says it alerted Bolsonaro’s office on August 2, with emails opened but not answered, and is working with the Federal Police and TSE to identify those responsible. Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s pre-candidate for president, cannot register his candidacy due to the irregular affiliation with Mission Party, whose presidential candidate is Renan Santos.

item.title: Missão alertou gabinete de Flávio sobre tentativa de fraude 10 dias antes
item.description: The Missão warned Flávio Bolsonaro’s office about an attempted fraud in his party affiliation since August 2, ten days before the registration change was made with the TSE. The information was disclosed in a subscriber-exclusive report.

item.title: Lula grava vídeo de campanha para petistas envolvidos no caso Master
item.description: President Lula recorded campaign videos to support three Bahia-based PT politicians implicated in the Banco Master case: Senator Jaques Wagner, former Minister Rui Costa, and Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues. Wagner had over R$ 400,000 seized in a PF raid linked to banker Daniel Vorcaro, while Costa and Rodrigues face scrutiny over the CredCesta payroll-deduction card scheme operated by Banco Master. Lula defends his support by invoking the presumption of innocence, citing the PT’s electoral dominance in Bahia since 2006 and the state’s strategic importance in his presidential victories since 2002.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio prepara ato na Paulista no 7 de Setembro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign is planning an event on Avenida Paulista on September 7th, symbolically tied to past Bolsonarist gatherings, as part of its electoral strategy. The campaign officially launches on Sunday (August 16th) with an act at Copacabana Beach, followed by a motorcycle rally in Juiz de Fora, Minas Gerais—both locations of strong symbolic value for Bolsonarism. These choices aim to replicate the format and symbols used by Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro pede ao TSE cancelamento de filiação ao Missão; caso será analisado por Nunes Marques
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign requested the TSE to cancel his alleged affiliation with the Missão party, claiming it was an unauthorized and fraudulent electronic alteration blocking his presidential candidacy registration. The case will be reviewed by TSE President Minister Nunes Marques following a meeting with Bolsonaro's legal team. Bolsonaro alleges a deliberate scheme to thwart his candidacy, while the Missão party states it was a victim of fraudulent affiliation and has notified authorities.

item.title: Gaspar nega acordo com Lira para ser vice de Flávio
item.description: Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) denied having any agreement with Arthur Lira (PP-AL) to be chosen as vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) ticket. He stated he did not approach Bolsonaro to join the ticket and that his nomination was independent. The comment was made in an interview with Meio-Dia em Brasília, from O Antagonista.

item.title: Parte da elite empresarial achou bacana a família de farsantes do Bolsonaro, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate from the Missão party, accused part of Brazil's business elite of having supported Jair Bolsonaro's family and remained silent amid criticisms from his political group, labeling Bolsonarism a 'farce'. He claims these entrepreneurs omitted themselves in the face of what he considers a fraudulent process involving the ex-president's family.

item.title: Se for necessária intervenção na Bahia ou no Ceará, faremos, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate of the Missão party for President of Brazil, stated on Thursday that he may resort to federal intervention in the states of Bahia, Ceará, and Rio de Janeiro if he deems local governments insufficiently combating organized crime. The remark underscores a hardline stance on federal oversight in public security.

item.title: 'Veto a visitas de Flávio Bolsonaro ao pai é legítimo', diz professor
item.description: UFF law professor Gustavo Sampaio stated that the ban on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro visiting his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest, is legitimate, in an interview with UOL News.
